arStrings.szText:
Skeleton Warriors explode on death, dealing {c_random}[(Owner.Weapon_Damage_Min_Total + Owner.Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total) * (1 + Owner.Main_Hand_Damage_Percent_Bonus) * Affix_Value_1]{/c} Physical damage to surrounding enemies. They lose {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"|%|]{/c} Life per second while in combat.

Skeleton Mages take {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"|%|]{/c} less damage and deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_2|x%1|]{/c} increased damage.
